jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Entry-Level Software QA Engineer** to join our engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of our **WordPress and Joomla plugins, extensions, and templates**. 

You will work closely with developers and product managers to test features, identify issues, and improve the overall user experience before each release. This is an excellent opportunity for freshers who want to build a strong foundation in **software quality assurance** and **CMS-based products**. 

### Key Responsibilities

*   **Manual Testing:** Test WordPress plugins/themes and Joomla extensions/templates across different browsers, devices, and screen resolutions.

*   **Test Documentation:** Create and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and QA checklists based on product requirements.

*   **Bug Reporting:** Identify, document, and track bugs clearly using tools like ClickUp. Work with developers to help reproduce issues.

*   **Regression Testing:** Re-test existing features after bug fixes and updates to ensure nothing breaks.

*   **Compatibility Testing:** Verify product compatibility with different versions of WordPress/Joomla, PHP, and hosting environments.

*   **Release Validation:** Assist the QA team in validating builds before releases and report any critical issues.

*   **User-Focused Testing:** Test products from an end-user perspective to identify usability and workflow issues.

### Required Qualifications

*   **CMS Knowledge:** Basic hands-on experience with **WordPress or Joomla**, including installing, configuring, and testing plugins or templates.

*   **Technical Basics:** Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP (ability to read and understand code, not write complex logic).

*   **QA Tools:**

    *   Familiarity with bug tracking or project management tools (ClickUp, Jira, etc.)

    *   Basic knowledge of API testing tools (Postman or similar)

    *   Experience using browser developer tools (Chrome DevTools)
*   **Performance Awareness:** Basic familiarity with tools like Google Lighthouse or GTmetrix.

*   **Mindset:** Detail-oriented, curious, and eager to learn. Enjoys finding bugs and improving product quality.

### Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)

*   Exposure to test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).

*   Basic knowledge of Git or version control systems.

*   Experience writing simple test scripts in JavaScript or PHP.

*   Familiarity with WP-CLI or PHPUnit.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Role Overview:**

*   The Sales Operations Lead will oversee the end-to-end distribution function across mass retail, distribution points, and direct and indirect workforce. The role carries full accountability for P&L performance, operational excellence, sales target achievement, stock integrity, and people development. The incumbent will be expected to strengthen existing trade & anchor company relationships while identifying and developing new business opportunities in line with company growth objectives.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Sales Target & Planning**

*   Develop and implement distribution or territory-wise sales plans to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual (AOP) revenue targets.
*   Maintain a structured daily sales rhythm including target tracking, DB level performance reviews, and timely escalation of shortfalls.
*   Conduct regular sales forecasting incorporating market trends, seasonal demand, and promotional activity.

**P&L Management & ROI Achievement**

*   Hold full accountability for the distribution P&L including revenue, distribution costs, OPEX, and net margin value (NMV).
*   Monitor and control operational expenditure, including manpower, vehicle, rent, and storage costs, ensuring alignment with approved budgets.
*   Track and evaluate ROI on distribution points, trade activations, and promotional investments; report findings to the Business Head on a regular basis.
*   Identify and address margin and operational leakages proactively; provide data-driven recommendations to improve overall profitability.

**Stock Management**

*   Ensure optimal stock availability across all distribution points to prevent stockouts on core SKUs as well as overstock issues to prevent excess working capital deployment.
*   Enforce FIFO discipline and conduct regular physical stock audits to ensure system records match actual inventory.
*   Monitor slow-moving inventory and initiate timely corrective actions such as redistribution or promotional push.
*   Maintain company policy for lost and damaged goods; all occurrences to be documented, investigated, and reported with zero tolerance for unaccounted losses.

**Payment Collection & Deposit Compliance**

*   Enforce credit limits and payment terms in line with company policy; exceptions to be approved by the Business Head.
*   Monitor daily collection tracker at the DB level; ensure all outstanding amounts are addressed within defined timelines.
*   Ensure all collections are deposited as per the agreed SLA; no deferral of deposits is permitted without formal approval.
*   Reconcile daily collections against invoices in coordination with the finance team; discrepancies to be resolved on the same day.
*   Monitor accounts receivable aging weekly and take appropriate commercial or escalation action on overdue accounts.

**Distribution Point Hygiene, Security & SOP Compliance**

*   Ensure all distribution points operate in strict accordance with company SOPs covering storage conditions, access control, and safety standards.
*   Conduct monthly DB audits across hygiene, product handling, equipment condition, and security protocols.
*   Ensure all DBs adhere to applicable regulatory and safety requirements including fire license, trade license, and any other licenses as per business requirements.

**Field Force Management & People Development**

*   Lead, monitor, and develop a multi-tier field team including Territory Officers and Distribution House Supervisors.
*   Set clear KPIs for all team members and conduct structured weekly performance reviews and daily ops meetings.
*   Plan and execute a monthly training calendar covering sales skills, SOP compliance, stock handling, and payment collection procedures.
*   Manage team onboarding, performance improvement, and succession planning in coordination with HR.
*   Conduct regular market visits and field coaching sessions to maintain execution standards across all territories.

**Relationship Management & New Business Development**

*   Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with all anchors and stakeholder companies.
*   Identify new market opportunities and develop business cases for expansion into underpenetrated areas.
*   Lead the onboarding of new distribution points and anchor partners, with clear activation plans and ROI projections.
*   Monitor competitor activity across pricing, promotions, and distribution; share market intelligence with the leadership team.
*   Collaborate with cross-functional teams including sales, finance, and product to support strategic initiatives and business planning.

*   Bachelor's degree in Business Administration.
*   MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification will be preferred.

*   At least 5 years
*   The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): E-commerce

*   Age At least 23 years

**Professional Experience:**

*   Minimum 5 years of experience in distribution, sales operations, modern trade operations, or supply chain management with direct P&L accountability.
*   Demonstrated track record of leading large multi-tier field teams across multiple locations.
*   Strong experience in stock management, trade finance, and distribution operations in an FMCG, trading, or distribution environment.
*   Proven ability to operate in high-growth, target-driven environments with a strong focus on execution and results.
